name: American Filament
summary: US filament brand claiming all its filament is made in Huntsville, Alabama, selling PLA+ (incl. Regenerative and Tough Pro), PLA, matte, silk and CMYK PLA, and a made-in-USA PCTG at roughly $26-30 per kg. Related to the Lithophane Maker product brand sold on the same site.

product_lines.name: Prototyping Filament
product_lines.notes: Base chemistry assumed PLA from the PLA product grouping; not explicitly stated.

product_lines.name: PCTG
product_lines.notes: Made-in-USA differentiator; $29.99 per 1 kg. Also listed by The Virtual Foundry shop.

additional_notes: americanfilament.com 301-redirects to americanfilament.us. Also sold via Gigaparts, WREKD and The Virtual Foundry. No OEM relationship found; the extruder is not named but the site claims Huntsville production. A 2026 reviewer listed it with 3D-Fuel as a US PCTG source.

provenance.conflicts: Huntsville manufacturing is an own-site claim only, not independently verified; no legal entity identified (footer reads only '(c) 2026, American Filament'). Gigaparts URL was seen as a search result.
